title: India's IT outsourcing industry feels AI's impact on hiring
excerpt: India's outsourcing giants are booking bigger profits with fewer employees. Clients now insist on paying for results, not hours worked
content_html:
Tata Consultancy Services, India's largest private employer, cut 12,200 middle and senior managers last year. It also trained 114,000 employees in AI. Both happened while the company posted record revenue of more than $30 billion.

TCS wasn't alone. Across India's five biggest IT services firms, every company earned more in fiscal year 2026 while employing fewer people. The combined workforce shrank by 7,389, according to Moneycontrol. The previous year, those same employers had added 12,718 jobs.

India's outsourcing industry employs nearly six million people and contributes an estimated 12% of the country's GDP. Economists have begun warning that AI could eliminate white-collar jobs faster than past waves of automation, and the sector where the entire business model depends on billing clients for human hours is where that's already happening.

India's growing IT revenue and its shrinking workforce

The cuts at TCS targeted experienced staff in roles "where redeployment and reskilling have not been feasible," according to The Federal. Infosys, the country's second-largest IT services firm, lost 8,440 workers in the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2026 alone, according to Moneycontrol, even as the company reported a 4.2% revenue increase in constant currency for fiscal year 2025.

AI services are filling the gap. Infosys CEO Salil Parekh told analysts that AI work accounted for 8.2% of total revenue by the first quarter of fiscal year 2027, growing at a double-digit pace. Srini Pallia, CEO of Wipro, another of India's top five IT firms, said in the company's second-quarter fiscal year 2026 earnings call that "AI is no longer experimental" and now "central to our clients' strategies."

Industry revenue grew 6.1% to $315 billion in fiscal year 2026, outpacing the 2.3% headcount increase to 5.95 million employees, according to Nasscom, the trade body that represents India's IT sector. Net additions of about 135,000 workers barely exceeded the prior year's 133,000. That's because the industry didn't need a bigger workforce. AI had contributed around 4% of total sector revenue, reaching the $10 billion to $12 billion range for the first time.

The collapse of hourly billing in Indian IT outsourcing

As AI handles more of the work, clients are asking why they should keep paying for the hours a human engineer needs to troubleshoot the problem. AI reduces the time needed to provide the same result, and the companies paying the bills have started demanding lower rates to match.

IT outsourcing contracts typically lock in rates for several years. Clients are now reopening them within two years of signing because AI has changed the economics mid-deal, according to HFS Research, a technology analyst firm. HFS Research CEO Phil Fersht said clients no longer want to pay billable hours, or by the number of engineers assigned to a project. They only want to pay for results, and they want a share of the savings AI creates by speeding up output. This paradigm shift is happening in real time. NelsonHall analyst Gaurav Parab told consulting firm StepTo that "AI is showing productivity gains within quarters, while in the past automation gains due to new technology took years to show up."

content_html_zh:
印度最大的私营雇主塔塔咨询服务公司去年裁减了12,200名中高级管理人员。 它还培训了 114,000 名人工智能员工。 这两件事都发生在该公司公布超过 300 亿美元创纪录收入的时候。

TCS 并不孤单。 在印度最大的五家 IT 服务公司中，每家公司在 2026 财年的收入都增加了，但雇用的员工却减少了。 根据 Moneycontrol 的数据，劳动力总数减少了 7,389 人。 去年，这些雇主增加了 12,718 个工作岗位。

印度的外包行业雇用了近 600 万人，估计占该国 GDP 的 12%。 经济学家已经开始警告说，人工智能可能会比过去的自动化浪潮更快地消除白领工作，而整个商业模式依赖于向客户收取工时费用的行业已经发生了这种情况。

印度不断增长的 IT 收入和不断减少的劳动力

据《联邦报》称，TCS 的裁员针对的是“无法进行重新部署和重新培训”的岗位上经验丰富的员工。 据 Moneycontrol 称，美国第二大 IT 服务公司印孚瑟斯 (Infosys) 仅在 2026 财年第四季度就流失了 8,440 名员工，尽管该公司公布 2025 财年按固定汇率计算的收入增长了 4.2%。

人工智能服务正在填补这一空白。 Infosys 首席执行官 Salil Parekh 告诉分析师，到 2027 财年第一季度，人工智能工作占总收入的 8.2%，以两位数的速度增长。 印度排名前五的另一家 IT 公司 Wipro 的首席执行官斯里尼·帕利亚 (Srini Pallia) 在该公司 2026 财年第二季度财报电话会议上表示，“人工智能不再是实验性的”，现在“是我们客户战略的核心”。

根据代表印度 IT 行业的贸易机构 Nasscom 的数据，2026 财年行业收入增长了 6.1%，达到 3150 亿美元，超过了员工人数增长 2.3% 的增幅，达到 595 万人。 净新增工人约 135,000 人，略高于上年的 133,000 人。 那是因为该行业不需要更多的劳动力。 人工智能贡献了行业总收入的 4% 左右，首次达到 100 亿至 120 亿美元的范围。

印度 IT 外包按小时计费的崩溃

随着人工智能处理更多的工作，客户会问为什么他们应该继续为人类工程师解决问题所需的时间付费。 人工智能减少了提供相同结果所需的时间，而支付账单的公司已经开始要求更低的费率来匹配。

IT 外包合同通常会锁定数年的费率。 技术分析公司 HFS Research 表示，由于人工智能改变了交易过程中的经济状况，客户现在在签约后两年内重新开放。 HFS Research 首席执行官菲尔·费什特 (Phil Fersht) 表示，客户不再愿意按按时间计费或按分配给项目的工程师数量付费。 他们只想为结果付费，并且希望分享人工智能通过加快产出而节省的成本。 这种范式转变正在实时发生。 NelsonHall 分析师 Gaurav Parab 告诉咨询公司 StepTo，“人工智能在几个季度内显示出生产力的提高，而在过去，新技术带来的自动化收益需要数年时间才能显现出来。”
